  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the lobby UI. Sets up the player and recipient lists, configures display elements, sets up listeners for map selection, and registers the controller. Ensures that UI elements are displayed and managed correctly.

    • addPlayer

      public void addPlayer(int clientID, String name, int figure, boolean ready)
      Adds a new player to the lobby. Creates a `PlayerEntry` with the given parameters and adds it to the player list, if no player with this ID exists yet. The own player name is marked with "(you)". Additionally, the player is added to the recipient ComboBox if it is not the own player.
      Parameters:
      clientID - The unique ID of the player.
      name - The name of the player.
      figure - The figure ID of the player.
      ready - Whether the player is ready.

    • showMapSelection

      public void showMapSelection(List<String> maps)

    • hideMapSelection

      public void hideMapSelection()
      Hides the map selection. Sets the visibility and management of the map selection box to invisible, disables the selection button and the map ComboBox. Called e.g. when the player is no longer ready.

    • setMapLabel

      public void setMapLabel(String text)
      Sets the text of the map label and shows the corresponding map preview. Extracts the map name from the given text and loads the corresponding preview image.
      Parameters:
      text - The text to display, e.g. "Selected map: MapName".

    • updatePlayerStatus

      public void updatePlayerStatus(int clientID, boolean isReady)
      Updates the readiness status of a player in the lobby. Sets the player's status, adjusts the order of ready players, and checks if the own player is now first. If so, shows the map selection, otherwise hides it. Updates the display of the player list.
      Parameters:
      clientID - The ID of the player whose status is changed.
      isReady - Whether the player is ready.

    • updatePlayerList

      public void updatePlayerList(List<PlayerEntry> newPlayers)
      Updates the player list in the lobby. Sets the given list as the new player list, removes all previous entries, and adds the new players. The own player is not added to the recipient ComboBox. Updates the display of the player list.
      Parameters:
      newPlayers - The new list of players to display.

    • appendChatMessage

      public void appendChatMessage(String message)
      Adds a chat message to the chat area. The given message is appended to the text field with a line break.
      Parameters:
      message - The chat message to display.

    • renamePlayer

      public void renamePlayer(int clientID, String newName)
      Changes the name of a player in the lobby. Searches for the player by the given ID and sets the new name. If it is the own player, appends "(you)". Updates the display of the player list after renaming.
      Parameters:
      clientID - The ID of the player whose name should be changed.
      newName - The new name to set.

    • getPlayers

      public List<PlayerEntry> getPlayers()
      Returns a list of all players in the lobby. Creates a new `PlayerEntry` object for each player, removing the "(you)" suffix from the name. The returned list contains the current data of all players.
      Returns:
      List of players in the lobby without the "(you)" name suffix.

    • getRoot

      Returns:
      The stored root element.

    • setRoot

      public void setRoot(javafx.scene.Parent root)
      Sets the root element of the lobby UI. Used to store the parent element for later access or adjustments.
      Parameters:
      root - The root element to set.
